findings.evidence: SessionMapper.toItem() and EntitlementService.toItem() were two independent private mappers producing the same CompositionItemResponse from the same SessionComposition — adding maxPlayCount to the record required updating both, and one was missed, causing a compile error masked by incremental compilation until a clean rebuild.
findings.why_it_matters: Two implementations of the same mapping will drift with every future field change to CompositionItemResponse, exactly as just happened.
findings.required_action: Made SessionMapper.toItem() public and had EntitlementService.checkEntitlement() call it directly instead of maintaining its own copy.
